Architecture: Three Stacks, One Policy Layer ¶1
results.quote: Against that record, Veldmark's reference architecture keeps three decision paths apart and puts one policy service over all of them (Figure 1).
results.finding: The spec declares cause_effect carrying over 'advertising is large, cyclical and, for sponsored listings and audiences, decided in the marketplace's own systems'. The preceding prose (p33) ends only on display's cyclicality, and 'Against that record' states no reason why the record leads to three separate paths; both flow readers said the link did not connect.

All other transition_in boundaries express their declared relationship: introduction (elaboration 'The term "advertising" hides', contrast 'does not re-teach', sequence roadmap); scene (example/additional_support/time/labelled sequence/'Ingrid's question ... was not'); concepts and in-practice section openers follow p11's 'The rest of this chapter is the answer'; architecture inner boundaries (elaboration, cause_effect 'The timeout trades', problem_solution 'Five rules', additional_support, place 'sit inside the result list', contrast 'closest to the core marketplace', cause_effect 'Five design choices', additional_support 'The regulatory floor', sequence, cause_effect 'where the privacy risk concentrates'); consent ('All three paths depend on consent', 'Three architectural consequences follow', 'Second', 'Third', 'also ... which matters because'); worked example (problem_solution, Decision labels, 'also accepted', 'took effect later, from the first quarter of 2028'); judging sections ('behind this design', 'differs by vertical', 'Without this chapter's design', 'preventing these failures raises', 'Ten questions test those five answers'); conclusion ('Advertising closes Part VI', 'The part's test asks', 'Each record depends on'). The hand-off link to part-7 is present (deterministic check).

results.draft_locus: In Practice: What the Public Record Shows ¶1
results.quote: Marketplaces publish advertising revenue more readily than advertising architecture, but the figures show how large and cyclical the business is and where its decisions run.
results.finding: The section's place is unclear to both readers: it draws only the Adevinta cyclicality lesson, which does not lead into the architecture, and its eBay, CarGurus, Autotrader and OLX rows are quoted again in full in the architecture subsections, so readers meet the same evidence twice. The duplication is specified by the spec (p32's table rows and p21/p24's evidence) and was kept by the decision log ('Notes not taken ... moving the public-company citations from p21 and p24 into In Practice'); both readers propose folding or moving the section, a change to the spec's order or evidence. The weak link into the architecture is reported separately as a transition failure.
results.corroborated_by: flow reader B, section 2 (In Practice marked 'unclear') and section 3 item 3 (flow reader A, item 5)
